text.title: FreshDrop, slow slot booking, 1–30 September 2026
text.problem: Slot booking fails in 38% of sessions; 22% of buyers leave at the slot step (July analytics)
text.hypothesis: If 2-hour slots are shown on the first screen, slot-to-order rises from 61% to 70%, because buyers stop scrolling
text.experiment: 2-hour slots on the home screen for 2 weeks in 2 districts, 50% of traffic
text.metrics: Slot-to-order at 70% or more confirms; below 65% drops the idea
text.subresults: Week 2: 2-hour slots picked 3 times more often; errors fell after the map fix
text.results: Confirmed: 71% in week 3 (target 70%). Decision: roll out to all Moscow districts from 1 October
